product.title: Ultimul regat
product.description: ULTIMUL REGAT este primul roman din seria de succes cu acelaşi nume scrisă de Bernard Cornwell, o cronică a istoriei Angliei de la începuturile sale, „la fel de captivantă ca Urzeala tronurilor, dar inspirată din evenimente reale“ (The Observer), serie care a stat la baza unui excepţional serial de televiziune realizat de BBC. LA MIJLOCUL secolului al IX-lea, fioroşii danezi năvălesc pe pământul britanic, dornici de jafuri şi cuceriri. Regat după regat cad pradă invadatorilor nemiloşi, până când unul singur rămâne. Astfel, soarta întregii Anglii şi cursul istoriei ajung să depindă de un singur om, de un singur rege. BERNARD CORNWELL scrie un roman istoric şi de aventuri excepţional, un roman despre curaj, trădare, datorie, devotament, măreţie, dragoste şi luptă, aşa cum se văd prin ochii unui tânăr războinic, a cărui loialitate este împărţită între două lumi.

# Ultimul Regat by Bernard Cornwell

Dive into an epic historical adventure with *Ultimul regat*, the compelling first novel in the successful series by Bernard Cornwell. This captivating story weaves together real history with thrilling tales of courage, betrayal, and destiny.

## An Epic Tale of England's Fate

*Ultimul regat* is a chronicle of the early history of England, set during a pivotal and turbulent time. Inspired by real events, this novel draws readers into the dramatic struggle for survival as the fate of the entire country hangs in the balance.

In the middle of the ninth century, fierce Danish invaders land on British soil, driven by a thirst for land and conquest. As war rages, the fate of all England depends on the actions of a single man and the decisions of a single king. Watch as the conflict unfolds, leading to a desperate struggle where only one victor remains.

## The Spirit of Adventure and Loyalty

Bernard Cornwell is renowned for writing exceptional historical fiction and adventure novels. This story perfectly captures the spirit of a young warrior whose loyalty is divided between two worlds, exploring profound themes such as courage, betrayal, duty, devotion, ambition, love, and relentless struggle. Experience an unforgettable narrative that highlights the complexities of leadership and survival.

## Why Read *Ultimul regat*?

If you enjoy historical narratives filled with intense action, deep character development, and high-stakes drama, this book is a must-read. It offers an immersive journey into the tumultuous history of England told through an unforgettable adventure story.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Who is the author of *Ultimul regat*?**
A: The book is written by Bernard Cornwell.

**Q: What historical period is this novel set in?**
A: The story is set in the middle of the ninth century, during the invasion of England by the Danes.

**Q: What themes does the book explore?**
A: The novel explores themes including courage, betrayal, duty, devotion, ambition, love, and the fight for survival.
